itinerary.title: White Water Rafting & Laxman Jhula
itinerary.details: Thrilling 16 km white water rafting on the Ganges. Visit Ram Jhula, Beatle's Ashram, and attend Parmarth Niketan Ganga Aarti.

itinerary.title: Drive to Mussoorie & Kempty Falls
itinerary.details: Drive up to Queen of Hills Mussoorie. Visit Kempty Falls, Gun Hill ropeway, and stroll along Mall Road and Camel's Back Road.

itinerary.title: Company Garden & Dehradun Drop
itinerary.details: Morning visit to Company Garden and Cloud's End before drop-off at Dehradun airport or railway station.

india.summary: Land of the Gods: Rugged Spiti Valleys, Rohtang Pass & Pine Forests

subDestinations.packageName: Spiti Valley Ultimate 4x4 Road Trip & Chandratal Lake
subDestinations.shortDescription: Journey through rugged moonscapes: Key Monastery, world's highest post office at Hikkim, Komic, and camping beside turquoise Chandratal Lake.
inclusions: 6 Nights Homestay & Swiss Camps (Shimla, Kalpa, Tabo, Kaza, Chandratal)
All Meals (Breakfast & Hot Dinners)
Experienced Spiti Route Road Captain & High-Altitude 4x4 Vehicle
Inner Line Permits & Monastery Entry Passes
Oxygen Cylinder on-board & High-Altitude First Aid Kit

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Kalpa (Kinnaur)
itinerary.details: Drive through the dramatic Hindustan-Tibet Highway carving into Himalayan cliffs. Sunset view of Kinner Kailash peak from Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Tabo via Nako Lake & Mummy Village
itinerary.details: Enter the high desert of Spiti. Visit Nako Lake, the 500-year-old self-mummified monk at Gue Village, and 1000-year-old UNESCO Tabo Monastery.

itinerary.title: Tabo to Dhankar & Kaza
itinerary.details: Visit cliff-hanging Dhankar Monastery overlooking confluence of Spiti and Pin rivers. Arrive in Kaza, the heart of Spiti Valley.

itinerary.title: High Altitude Villages (Key, Kibber, Hikkim, Komic, Langza)
itinerary.details: Visit 1000-year-old Key Monastery, Chicham Bridge (highest suspension bridge), world's highest village Komic, post a letter at Hikkim Post Office, and hunt for fossils in Langza.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal Lake (The Moon Lake)
itinerary.details: Cross Kunzum Pass (4,551m). Hike to the enchanting crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake reflecting snow peaks. Camp under millions of stars.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.details: Drive through Batal and the world-renowned Atal Tunnel to lush green Manali. Rest and cafe hopping in Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.details: Scenic morning drive along the Beas river back to Chandigarh airport/railway station.

subDestinations.packageName: Manali, Solang Valley Snow & Kasol Parvati Trails
subDestinations.shortDescription: Snow activities at Solang Valley, cafe culture in Old Manali, Manikaran hot springs, and serene riverside vibes in Kasol.
inclusions: 4 Nights Stay in Premium Mountain Resorts / Riverside Camps
Daily Breakfast & Dinners with Bonfire Night
Solang Valley Adventure Sightseeing & Atal Tunnel Drive
Kasol Cafe Tour & Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara Visit
Private AC Cab for all Sightseeing
exclusions: Paragliding / Skiing / ATV charges at Solang

itinerary.title: Chandigarh to Manali Scenic Drive
itinerary.details: Drive past Mandi, Pandoh Dam, and Kullu Valley. Check in to Manali mountain resort.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Excursion
itinerary.details: Enjoy paragliding, zorbing, and snow activities at Solang Valley. Drive through Atal Tunnel to Sissu waterfall.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Heritage & Old Manali Cafes
itinerary.details: Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs, Manu Temple, and evening shopping on Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol & Manikaran Hot Springs
itinerary.details: Drive to Kasol in Parvati Valley. Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and enjoy riverside cafe hopping.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.details: Morning nature walk along Parvati river before drive back to Chandigarh.

india.summary: One State, Many Worlds: Gokarna Beaches, Hampi Ruins & Coorg Coffee Estates

subDestinations.packageName: Gokarna 5-Beach Trek, Kumta Coast & Murudeshwar
subDestinations.shortDescription: Cliff-side beach trekking connecting Om Beach, Half Moon Beach & Paradise Beach, pristine Kumta Nirvana beach, and giant Murudeshwar Shiva.
inclusions: 2 Nights Stay in Beachfront Shack / Resort in Gokarna
Daily Breakfast & Dinners
Guided 5-Beach Cliff Trek & Sunset Point Walk
Kumta Nirvana Beach & Murudeshwar Shiva Temple Excursion
Private Cab Transfers from Gokarna / Goa / Hubli

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gokarna & Kudle Beach Sunset
itinerary.details: Pickup from Gokarna Road railway station or Goa/Hubli. Check in to beachfront resort. Relax at Kudle Beach with seaside cafe dinner.

itinerary.title: Famous 5-Beach Trek (Om, Half Moon, Paradise, Belekan)
itinerary.details: Guided morning cliff trek over the Arabian Sea connecting Gokarna main beach, Kudle, Om Beach, Half Moon Beach, and Paradise Beach. Sunset boat ride.

itinerary.title: Kumta Nirvana Beach, Mirjan Fort & Murudeshwar
itinerary.details: Visit secluded Kumta Nirvana Beach and historic Mirjan Fort. Explore the colossal 123-ft Murudeshwar Shiva statue on the ocean edge before departure.

subDestinations.packageName: Hampi UNESCO Bouldering & Vijayanagara Empire Heritage
subDestinations.shortDescription: Step back in time to the world's 2nd largest medieval era city: Virupaksha Temple, Stone Chariot, and Hippie Island sunsets.
inclusions: 2 Nights Stay in Boutique Heritage Resort / Riverside Stay
Daily Breakfast & South Indian Thali Lunches
Licensed Archaeological Guide for Royal Enclosure & Vittala Temple
Coracle Boat Ride across Tungabhadra River
All Sightseeing Transfers & Entry Tickets

itinerary.title: Hampi Arrival & Virupaksha Sunset at Hemakuta Hill
itinerary.details: Pickup from Hospet railway station. Settle into riverside resort. Afternoon visit to Virupaksha Temple and watch golden sunset from Hemakuta Hill boulders.

itinerary.title: Vittala Temple Stone Chariot & Royal Center
itinerary.details: Explore the iconic Stone Chariot and musical pillars at Vijaya Vittala Temple, Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stables, and Queen's Bath with expert historian.

itinerary.title: Anjaneya Hill Sunrise, Coracle Ride & Departure
itinerary.details: Climb Anjaneya Hill (birthplace of Lord Hanuman) for 360-degree boulder landscape sunrise. Enjoy traditional coracle boat ride on Tungabhadra river before departure.

india.summary: Enchanting Dravidian Architecture, Spiritual Island & Nilgiri Hills

subDestinations.packageName: Rameshwaram Jyotirlinga, Dhanushkodi Ram Setu & Madurai Meenakshi
subDestinations.shortDescription: Sacred Pamban Sea Bridge, 22 Holy Teerthams at Ramanathaswamy Temple, ghost town Dhanushkodi, and Madurai Meenakshi Amman.
inclusions: 2 Nights in Rameshwaram Hotel + 1 Night in Madurai Hotel
Daily Breakfast & Authentic Tamil Meals
Pamban Bridge Scenic Crossing & Dhanushkodi 4x4 Beach Trip
Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple VIP Darshan Pass
All Sightseeing Transfers in Private AC Cab

itinerary.title: Madurai Arrival to Rameshwaram via Pamban Bridge
itinerary.details: Pickup from Madurai airport/station. Drive to Rameshwaram crossing the magnificent Pamban Sea Bridge over the Indian Ocean. Evening Darshan at Ramanathaswamy Temple.

itinerary.title: 22 Holy Teerthams & APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial
itinerary.details: Early morning holy bath in the 22 consecrated water wells inside Ramanathaswamy Temple corridor (longest pillared corridor in the world). Visit Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam National Memorial.

itinerary.title: Dhanushkodi Ghost Town, Ram Setu & Drive to Madurai
itinerary.details: Explore Dhanushkodi, the lost city destroyed in the 1964 cyclone, and Arichal Munai (starting point of Ram Setu where Indian Ocean meets Bay of Bengal). Drive to Madurai.

itinerary.title: Madurai Meenakshi Temple & Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
itinerary.details: Morning visit to the thousand-pillared Meenakshi Amman Temple and royal Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace. Drop at Madurai airport.

india.summary: Heaven on Earth: Dal Lake Shikaras, Gulmarg Gondolas & Snow Valleys

subDestinations.packageName: Kashmir Paradise: Luxury Houseboat, Gulmarg & Pahalgam
subDestinations.shortDescription: Glide on Dal Lake in a royal Shikara, ride the world's second highest Gondola in Gulmarg, and stroll Betaab Valley in Pahalgam.
inclusions: 1 Night in Luxury Dal Lake Houseboat + 4 Nights in 4-Star Mountain Hotels
Daily Breakfast & Kashmiri Wazwan Dinners
Private 2-Hour Shikara Sunset Ride on Dal Lake
Mughal Gardens Entry (Nishat, Shalimar, Chashme Shahi)
Private AC Cab for all transfers and mountain excursions

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake Shikara
itinerary.details: Arrive at Srinagar Airport. Transfer to luxury carved wooden houseboat. Enjoy evening romantic Shikara ride across floating vegetable markets.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Mughal Gardens & Old City
itinerary.details: Explore Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Hazratbal Shrine. Evening shopping for Pashmina shawls and saffron.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Meadow of Flowers & Gondola Ride
itinerary.details: Day excursion to Gulmarg. Take the world-famous Gondola cable car to Apharwat Peak (13,780 ft) for skiing and snow activities.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds)
itinerary.details: Drive past saffron fields of Pampore and Awantipora ruins to Pahalgam. Check into riverside hotel along Lidder River.

itinerary.title: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari
itinerary.details: Full day exploration of picturesque Betaab Valley, scenic Aru Valley, and Chandanwari (starting point of Amarnath Yatra).

itinerary.title: Srinagar Airport Departure
itinerary.details: Morning breakfast by Lidder river and comfortable transfer back to Srinagar airport.

india.summary: Land of High Passes: Pangong Tso, Nubra Dunes & Khardung La

subDestinations.packageName: Leh Ladakh Pangong Tso, Nubra & Khardung La 4x4 Circuit
subDestinations.shortDescription: Traverse the highest motorable road Khardung La, ride double-humped Bactrian camels at Nubra, and camp by changing blue Pangong Tso.
inclusions: 3 Nights Hotel in Leh + 1 Night Deluxe Camp in Nubra + 1 Night Lake Camp at Pangong
Daily Breakfast & Warm Buffet Dinners
Inner Line Protected Area Permits & Environmental Fees
Dedicated Leh Chauffeur & Oxygen Cylinder in Vehicle
All Sightseeing & Monastery Entrances

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Acclimatization
itinerary.details: Arrive at Leh Airport (11,500 ft). Check into hotel and rest for high-altitude acclimatization. Evening sunset visit to Shanti Stupa.

itinerary.title: Sham Valley (Magnetic Hill, Sangam, Hall of Fame)
itinerary.details: Visit Hall of Fame war museum, Kali Mata Temple, Magnetic Hill gravity-defying spot, and confluence of Indus and Zanskar rivers.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La (17,582 ft)
itinerary.details: Cross the iconic Khardung La Pass. Descend into Nubra Valley. Visit Diskit Monastery (106-ft Maitreya Buddha) and ride Bactrian camels at Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso via Shyok River
itinerary.details: Drive along scenic Shyok River to world-famous Pangong Tso Lake (14,270 ft). Witness changing shades of turquoise and deep blue. Camp under night sky.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh via Chang La Pass (17,590 ft)
itinerary.details: Catch mesmerizing sunrise over Pangong Lake. Return drive to Leh via Chang La Pass. Visit Thiksey and Shey Monasteries.

itinerary.title: Leh Airport Departure
itinerary.details: Transfer to Leh Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport with lifelong memories.

india.summary: The Royal State: Golden Sand Dunes, Majestic Forts & Lake Palaces

subDestinations.packageName: Royal Rajasthan: Jaipur, Jodhpur & Lake City Udaipur
subDestinations.shortDescription: Amber Fort elephant trails, Mehrangarh cliff-top fortress, romantic boat ride on Lake Pichola, and grand Rajasthani folk dances.
inclusions: 5 Nights Stay in Heritage 4-Star Haveli Hotels
Daily Royal Breakfast & Authentic Rajasthani Dinners (Dal Baati Churma)
Private AC Cab for inter-city travel & local sightseeing
Lake Pichola Sunset Boat Cruise in Udaipur
Chokhi Dhani Cultural Village Entry & Dinner Experience

itinerary.title: Jaipur Arrival & City Palace
itinerary.details: Arrive in Jaipur Pink City. Visit City Palace, Jantar Mantar observatory, and photo stop at Hawa Mahal. Evening traditional dinner at Chokhi Dhani.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort, Nahargarh & Jal Mahal
itinerary.details: Ascend grand Amber Fort. Explore Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors), Jaigarh Fort, Nahargarh panoramic sunset, and water palace Jal Mahal.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur (The Blue City)
itinerary.details: Drive to Sun City Jodhpur. Check into heritage hotel. Visit majestic Mehrangarh Fort perched 400 ft above the blue city, and Jaswant Thada.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Udaipur via Ranakpur Jain Temples
itinerary.details: Drive to Udaipur stopping at the 1,444 uniquely carved marble pillars of Ranakpur Jain Temple. Arrive in Udaipur City of Lakes.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Lake Pichola Boat Cruise
itinerary.details: Tour majestic City Palace overlooking Lake Pichola. Visit Saheliyon Ki Bari and enjoy evening sunset boat cruise admiring Lake Palace & Jagmandir.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Departure
itinerary.details: Morning shopping for miniature paintings and silver jewelry before transfer to Udaipur Airport.

india.summary: God's Own Country: Emerald Tea Plantations, Backwater Cruises & Ayurvedic Spas

subDestinations.packageName: Munnar Misty Tea Hills & Alleppey Private Houseboat Cruise
subDestinations.shortDescription: Explore sprawling tea estates of Munnar, spot Nilgiri Tahr in Eravikulam, and drift through palm-fringed backwaters on a private AC houseboat.
inclusions: 2 Nights in Munnar Valley View Resort + 1 Night in Thekkady + 1 Night Private AC Houseboat in Alleppey
All Meals on Houseboat (Authentic Kerala Sadhya, Fish Fry, Coconut Curry)
Breakfasts included at all hotels
Tea Museum & Spice Plantation Tour with Tasting
Private AC Sedan with dedicated Chauffeur

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar Tea Gardens
itinerary.details: Pickup from Cochin Airport/railway station. Drive past Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls to hill station Munnar. Settle into valley resort.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing (Eravikulam & Mattupetty)
itinerary.details: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to endangered Nilgiri Tahr), Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Tata Tea Museum.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Plantations
itinerary.details: Scenic drive to Thekkady (Periyar). Guided aromatic spice plantation tour (cardamom, pepper, vanilla) and attend Kathakali cultural show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Private Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.details: Board traditional Kerala Kettuvallam (Houseboat) in Alleppey. Cruise tranquil lagoons, paddy fields, and canals. On-board freshly cooked Kerala feast.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin Departure
itinerary.details: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Visit Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets and Jew Town before Cochin Airport transfer.

india.summary: Sun, Sand, Portuguese Architecture & Vibrant Nightlife

subDestinations.packageName: Goa Sun & Surf: North Goa Nightlife, Dudhsagar Safari & South Goa Serenity
subDestinations.shortDescription: Exciting water sports, 4x4 jungle jeep safari to Dudhsagar Waterfalls, Portuguese heritage of Old Goa, and pristine South Goa beaches.
inclusions: 3 Nights 4-Star Resort Stay with Swimming Pool near Beach
Daily Buffet Breakfast
Dudhsagar 4x4 Jeep Safari with Spice Plantation Lunch
Mandovi River Sunset Cruise with Goan Folk Dance
Airport / Railway Station Transfers & Sightseeing Cab
exclusions: Water sports charges at Baga / Calangute

itinerary.title: Goa Arrival & North Goa Beaches
itinerary.details: Pickup from Goa Airport (GOI/GOX) or Madgaon/Thivim station. Check into resort. Evening relaxation at Baga and Calangute beach shacks.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfall Jeep Safari & Spice Plantation
itinerary.details: Thrilling 4x4 open jeep safari through Mollem National Park jungle to the milky cascade of Dudhsagar. Traditional Goan buffet lunch at spice plantation.

itinerary.title: South Goa Heritage, Miramar Beach & Sunset Cruise
itinerary.details: Visit Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa, Dona Paula viewpoint, Miramar Beach, and 1-hour sunset cruise on Mandovi River.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Departure
itinerary.details: Shop for Goan feni, cashews, and handicrafts in Panaji before airport drop-off.

india.summary: Land of Five Rivers: Golden Temple, Patriotic Wagah Border & Rich Heritage

subDestinations.packageName: Amritsar Golden Temple, Wagah Border & Punjabi Culinary Journey
subDestinations.shortDescription: Spiritual bliss at the glistening Golden Temple, world's largest free community kitchen (Langar), and electrifying Wagah Border beating retreat.
inclusions: 2 Nights Stay in 4-Star Hotel near Golden Temple
Daily Breakfast & Authentic Amritsari Kulcha / Lassi Food Tour
Special Reserved Seating Assistance for Wagah Border Ceremony
Jallianwala Bagh & Partition Museum Tour
Private AC Cab for all Sightseeing & Transfers

itinerary.title: Amritsar Arrival & Night Golden Temple Palki Sahib
itinerary.details: Arrive at Amritsar. Visit Sri Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple). Volunteer at Guru Ka Langar and witness the serene Night Palki Sahib ceremony.

itinerary.title: Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum & Wagah Border
itinerary.details: Morning visit to historic Jallianwala Bagh and the emotional Partition Museum. Afternoon excursion to India-Pakistan Wagah Border for the high-energy military ceremony.

itinerary.title: Gobindgarh Fort, Food Walk & Departure
itinerary.details: Explore Maharaja Ranjit Singh's Gobindgarh Fort, indulge in authentic Amritsari Kulchas and sweet Lassi at famous street joints before airport drop.

india.summary: Unexplored Paradise: Kanchenjunga Vistas, Crystal Dawki River & Living Root Bridges

subDestinations.packageName: Gangtok, Tsomgo High-Altitude Lake & Darjeeling Tiger Hill
subDestinations.shortDescription: Marvel at Mt. Kanchenjunga sunrise from Tiger Hill, ride the Darjeeling Himalayan Toy Train, and visit glacial Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir.
inclusions: 3 Nights Hotel in Gangtok + 2 Nights in Darjeeling
Daily Breakfast & Dinners
Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Special Permit & 4x4 Transfer
Darjeeling 7-Point Sightseeing & Tiger Hill Sunrise Tour
Dedicated Mountain Cab with Experienced Chauffeur
exclusions: Nathula Pass permit fee (subject to army availability)

itinerary.title: Bagdogra/NJP to Gangtok
itinerary.details: Pickup from Bagdogra Airport or NJP railway station. Scenic drive along Teesta River to Gangtok (5,500 ft). Evening stroll on MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Glacial Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
itinerary.details: Drive up to the sacred, mirror-like Tsomgo Lake (12,400 ft) surrounded by alpine peaks. Visit historic Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sights to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Visit Rumtek Monastery, Ban Jhakri Waterfall, and Ropeway. Afternoon scenic drive through lush tea hills to Darjeeling (6,700 ft).

itinerary.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Darjeeling Heritage
itinerary.details: Early 4:00 AM trip to Tiger Hill to watch golden sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga. Visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, and Happy Valley Tea Estate.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Mountain Leisure & Toy Train
itinerary.details: Ride the UNESCO World Heritage Darjeeling Himalayan Toy Train. Enjoy tea tasting at Glenary's bakery.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Bagdogra Departure
itinerary.details: Descent through Kurseong tea gardens to Bagdogra airport for onward journey.

india.summary: Tropical Paradise: Radhanagar Beach, Coral Reefs & Historic Cellular Jail

subDestinations.packageName: Havelock Island Radhanagar Beach, Neil Island & Cellular Jail
subDestinations.shortDescription: Asia's best beach at Radhanagar Havelock, coral reef snorkeling at Elephant beach, natural rock bridge at Neil Island, and Cellular Jail Light & Sound.
inclusions: 2 Nights Luxury Beach Resort in Havelock + 1 Night in Neil + 1 Night in Port Blair
Daily Breakfast & Oceanfront Dinners
High-Speed Luxury AC Cruise Tickets (Makruzz/Nautika between islands)
Complimentary 1 Snorkeling Session with Guide at Elephant Beach
Cellular Jail Entry & Sound & Light Show Tickets
exclusions: Scuba diving / Sea karting / Parasailing optional add-ons

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival & Cellular Jail Light Show
itinerary.details: Arrive at Port Blair Airport. Settle in hotel. Afternoon visit to historic Cellular Jail (Kala Pani) and attend the moving Light & Sound Show.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island & Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.details: Board luxury high-speed catamaran cruise to Havelock Island. Check in to beachfront resort. Spend the evening at Radhanagar Beach (Time Magazine's Best Beach in Asia) watching breathtaking sunset.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Neil Island Cruise
itinerary.details: Speedboat ride to Elephant Beach for snorkeling amidst vibrant coral reefs and marine life. Afternoon cruise to tranquil Neil Island. Sunset at Laxmanpur Beach.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Natural Bridge & Return to Port Blair
itinerary.details: Visit the unique Howrah Natural Coral Bridge and Bharatpur beach. Cruise back to Port Blair. Evening souvenir shopping for shell crafts at Sagarika Emporium.

itinerary.title: Port Blair Departure
itinerary.details: Breakfast by the sea and transfer to Veer Savarkar International Airport.
